output.subject: Your question about the personal information we hold
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch with us. You asked what personal information we keep about you and who we share it with, and you mentioned that you would like a copy of that information if that is something we provide.

These are reasonable questions, and we want to make sure you get a clear and accurate answer. Your request is now with our Privacy Office, who will review it and respond to you within 10 business days. Their reply will cover both parts of your message: the information we hold and who it is shared with, and your request for a copy.

If there is any particular information you are most interested in, or anything else you would like us to consider, please reply to this message and we will make sure the Privacy Office has it.

Thank you again for reaching out to us.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a question, not a complaint; the reply is written as a response to an inquiry.
Decide whether to handle this as a formal request for access to personal data, and check whether any legal deadline is shorter than 10 business days.
Confirm what identity verification is needed before any personal information is released.
Decide whether a copy will be provided, and in what format and through what delivery method.
The draft does not describe data categories or sharing practices; add specifics or point to the relevant privacy notice if appropriate.
